Recommendation: Add Escape key listener to navigation disclosure toggle
Validation: Press Escape on open mobile menu on /contact/

Problem: Forms lack a top-level role=alert submission summary upon validation failure
UserImpact: Screen reader users hear no immediate global summary upon submit failure
Recommendation: Add top-level form submission alert summary with role=alert
Validation: Submit invalid form and test screen reader announcement

Validation: Inspect product tab bar on 360px viewport

Problem: Product title column in dense price tables is not sticky during mobile horizontal scroll

Validation: Test horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports
